title: Huiswerk maken bij de televisie of geluidsmedia 1993
authors: Koolstra, C.M., Beentjes, J.W.J., Voort, T.H.A. van der (primary investigator)
contributors: C.M. Koolstra, Vrije Universiteit, Fac. Sociale Wetenschappen, Communicatiewetenschappen (depositor)
Stichting voor onderzoek van het onderwijs SVO * Den Haag (research initiator)
Rijksuniversiteit Leiden, Pedagogisch Instituut, Sectie kind en media (data collector)
descriptions: Doing homework near to tv, radio etc. Time spent on doing homework / attitude to do homework / capacity to concentrate / doing homework in combination with listening to music or watching television / influence of music or tv on r.'s homework performance / (a distinction has been made between "learning" tasks and "making" tasks) / favourite tv and radio stations and programs / favourite kind of music. Background variables: basic characteristics/ education/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
